title: Vibing Clouds
description: VibeVoice-ASR speech-to-text (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible) for the Vibing dictation app. Sends base64 audio, returns a transcript. Gemma polish is available but off by default in this spike.

input.name: Enable Gemma polish
input.description: Load Gemma-4 for transcript polish. Off for the ASR-only spike; needs a 24GB+ card and an HF token for the gated model when on.

input.name: ASR GPU memory fraction
input.description: vLLM --gpu-memory-utilization for VibeVoice-ASR. Keep 0.88 on L4 to leave room for multimodal startup profiling.

input.name: ASR max model length
input.description: vLLM --max-model-len. Keep 256 for L4 smoke tests; raise only for longer audio on larger GPUs.

input.name: ASR max sequences
input.description: vLLM --max-num-seqs. Vibing sends one dictation request at a time, so 1 minimizes startup memory.

input.name: ASR batch token cap
input.description: vLLM --max-num-batched-tokens. Keep equal to max model length for one short dictation request.

input.name: ASR output token cap
input.description: OpenAI max_tokens for the ASR response. Keep small for the RunPod smoke WAV.

input.name: ASR eager mode
input.description: Set to 1 to disable CUDA graph capture and reduce vLLM startup memory on 24GB GPUs.
